g.text: BOOT controls do not depend on application firmware.

g.desc: BOOT controls do not depend on application firmware.

g.text: Q1/Q2 hold the peer reset. Q3/Q4 force selected ROM boot.

g.desc: Q1/Q2 hold the peer reset. Q3/Q4 force selected ROM boot.

g.text: RP_BOOT_N joins QSPI_SS through this sheet's 1k path.

g.desc: RP_BOOT_N joins QSPI_SS through this sheet's 1k path.

g.text: 27R RP and 22R ESP series resistors belong at MCU pins.

g.desc: 27R RP and 22R ESP series resistors belong at MCU pins.

g.text: Select mode ONLY with USB unplugged and 3V3 discharged.

g.desc: Select mode ONLY with USB unplugged and 3V3 discharged.

g.text: One shunt: RUN=1-2; FLASH RP=3-4; FLASH ESP=5-6.

g.desc: One shunt: RUN=1-2; FLASH RP=3-4; FLASH ESP=5-6.

g.text: Both FLASH shunts: both USB switches disabled; both CPUs reset.

g.desc: Both FLASH shunts: both USB switches disabled; both CPUs reset.

g.text: RUN_MODE additionally qualifies the future Zorro output-enable circuit.

g.desc: RUN_MODE additionally qualifies the future Zorro output-enable circuit.

g.text: CANDIDATE R0 - USB / POWER / PHYSICAL RECOVERY

g.desc: CANDIDATE R0 - USB / POWER / PHYSICAL RECOVERY

g.text: Integration interfaces J3/J4 are temporary schematic boundaries.

g.desc: Integration interfaces J3/J4 are temporary schematic boundaries.

g.text: NOT A FABRICATION RELEASE. See proposal.md and review/verification.md.

g.desc: NOT A FABRICATION RELEASE. See proposal.md and review/verification.md.

g.text: Power selection: CC OUT1 low permits main power.

g.desc: Power selection: CC OUT1 low permits main power.

g.text: FUSB303B GPIO mode: ADDR left open; PORT via 100k to GND.

g.desc: FUSB303B GPIO mode: ADDR left open; PORT via 100k to GND.

g.text: TPS22917 CT capacitor goes to VIN, NOT GND.

g.desc: TPS22917 CT capacitor goes to VIN, NOT GND.

g.text: No board placement or USB impedance claim at this stage.

g.desc: No board placement or USB impedance claim at this stage.

g.text: USB-C is ALWAYS a power sink. Run uses internal D+/D- only.

g.desc: USB-C is ALWAYS a power sink. Run uses internal D+/D- only.

g.text: Supply / data-capable PC port must advertise >=1.5 A.

g.desc: Supply / data-capable PC port must advertise >=1.5 A.

g.text: Default-current ports intentionally leave main rail OFF.

g.desc: Default-current ports intentionally leave main rail OFF.

g.text: No external VBUS-source switch. No Amiga +5V power connection.

g.desc: No external VBUS-source switch. No Amiga +5V power connection.
